'''Nemesis One''' was the callsign given to [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] during his indoctrination sessions on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' conducted by [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]].
